notes.title: My Grandpa's Haunted House is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/790333ded9d21fb050514d8d603107c5284a16b8.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new 50th title called My Grandpa's Haunted House which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Survival horror games then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870070/My_Grandpas_Haunted_House/


Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Indie Horror Games Bundle #2[/b] for celebrating the release of my 50th project called My Grandpa's Haunted House game on Steam and if you would like to purchase multiple horror games at a huge discount then this is your chance.

[h1]Get Indie Horror Games Bundle #2 here:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33469/Indie_Horror_Games_Bundle_2/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #1 - Some Fixes for Jump Limit and Others
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some of the issues have been fixed with this update. 

1. There should have been a jump limit of 5000 times but for some reason, it was just allowing the player to jump only 5 times. 
With this update, this issue has been successfully fixed. 

2. Some minor bugs have been fixed and any further bugs will be fixed based on the community feedback.

I would like to clarify some information related to red, blue and green stars which you collect in some levels. There are no separate numbers for blue and green stars since they are added to the main score of the game.

For instance, if you receive a yellow star, you get 5 scores. If you receive a red star you get 200 scores, for a blue star, you receive 1000 scores and for the green star, you receive 500 scores. 

That means, whichever star you collect in the process the value is added to your total score.  The achievements will pop up only when you collect blue, red and green stars for the first time. 

I hope it helps. Please download the updated version through your Steam client and enjoy the game.

More Games To Play:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/886010/Smash_Halloween_Pumpkins_The_Challenge/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/897420/The_Christmas_Gifts/

Best Regards,
Anamik
